meaning: MODEL_READY means independently verified named model/protocol; not complete paper or material reproduction

capabilities.name: NMEE
capabilities.capability: E × B → spin magnetization; full finite-frequency multiband/PT response
capabilities.units: H: eV; k: nm^-1; dynamic response: (nm V T)^-1 for s/mu_B
limits: Named AC/static/printed protocols are separate; no completed intrinsic metallic DC extraction
Same-gauge physical spin and position connection required

capabilities.name: Spin transport
capabilities.capability: E / E² → spin polarization and conventional spin current
capabilities.units: e=hbar=1; physical spin sigma/2; BZ measure d2k/(2pi)^2
limits: Full finite-frequency result is not automatically isolated tau^0
Conventional spin current is not generally conserved with spin-orbit torque

capabilities.name: Magnetotransport
capabilities.capability: Spin/orbital PHE and MNHE in the declared paper-model protocols
capabilities.units: Per-channel normalization: see JSON; natural units and selected SI bridges are distinct
limits: General multiband orbital positional shift is not completed
Finite-device conductance is not interchangeable with bulk mixed E/B response

capabilities.name: Curvature–Flux
capabilities.capability: Zeeman geometry, Dirac flux/winding, interband GHE/KME
capabilities.units: hbar=1; source omega=-drive omega; source KME observable sigma/2
limits: Whole Table I not certified; use physical model symmetry checks
Interband response excludes full metallic intraband/collision response

capabilities.name: IGMC
capabilities.capability: Rashba/Dirac conduction and displacement magnetic current
capabilities.units: H: eV; k: Angstrom^-1; explicit Hz/rad/s; plotted SI coefficient A/(m T)
limits: Two-band nondegenerate, nonresonant model scope
Author Fig2(d) amplitude and complete Eq14 convention remain unresolved

capabilities.name: Ezawa magnetic BPVE
capabilities.capability: 2D Rashba d-wave altermagnet: linearly polarized magnetic injection current from quantum metric
capabilities.units: E/eps0; k/k0; normalized sigma/[tau*e^3/(hbar^2*W*k0)]; no material SI calibration
limits: Only two-band nondegenerate, monotonic-contour clean model with zero-T Pauli occupation
Not a Wannier injection/shift calculator; published x;yy Eq.(19) disagrees with direct Eq.(7) integration; retained as discrepancy

capabilities.name: Layer-orbital IMHE
capabilities.capability: Declared fixed-reference orbital-moment Hamiltonian: multiband mixed Berry/energy derivatives and geometric Hall/band-drift coefficients
capabilities.units: e=hbar=1; dimensionless k; explicit d2k/(2pi)^2; per probe u*b, drift per tau; no SI calibration
limits: Independent periodic three-band model, not source R5G figures or a nonquantized insulating plateau
Fixed orthonormal basis and nondegenerate bands; reference A5 moment frozen under probes; explicit C required for extra mixed contacts
Full refers only to stated Berry-current and band-drift functionals; no Lorentz force, phase-space drift correction or disorder vertices
A4 sign and A8-like second-order-state truncation conflicts are documented; no forced source normalization

capabilities.name: Zou 2025 deep band crossings / SHG
capabilities.capability: Source-defined 3-orbital tight-binding and leading DBC-induced SHG interband/mixed cancellation
capabilities.units: SM TB energy units; dimensionless lattice momentum; hbar=1; local SHG normalization omits e^3/(2hbar^2) and BZ integration
limits: Local leading 1/q singularity cancellation only; finite terms of SM S7 and full SHG susceptibility not computed
No finite-BZ shift conductivity full spectrum calibration; no GeTe DFT/Wannier, SOC or HSE
Off-resonant frequency 0.7*epsilon0, insulating three-band v/c/c' occupations, no exact degeneracy or physical linewidth

capabilities.name: Finite-width optical critical-point design
capabilities.capability: Conditional 2D normal-shift design: finite-width criticality, competing optical edge and independent projector reference
capabilities.units: Model energy in eV; dimensionless k; d2k/(2pi)^2; Gaussian sigma / Lorentzian HWHM; SI prefactor and thickness omitted
limits: Explicit insulating three-orbital paths and conditional local normal form; no material/DFT or global optimum certification
Projector reference only for smooth isolated scalar-energy subspaces; no flattening of split bands
Spectral convolution is not a microscopic lifetime; full SHG, excitons and device efficiency excluded
Real Wannier optical operators require independent same-gauge validation
